class.name: GameplayTagContainer
class.brief_description: A set of explicit gameplay tags with hierarchical and exact matching.
class.description: Use a container for the several tags a character has or an action requires. A character with [code]state.control.stun[/code] satisfies a hierarchical check for [code]state.control[/code]. An exact check for [code]state.control[/code] requires its own explicit entry. Export a container to manage its entries in the Inspector. Use [method copy] when independent runtime owners need to modify a shared resource.

method.name: add
method.description: Adds [param tag] as an explicit member. Returns whether the set changed. An invalid tag, a missing tag, or an existing explicit member leaves the set unchanged.

method.name: add_leaf
method.description: Adds [param tag] and removes its explicit ancestors. Returns [code]true[/code] when [param tag] was already exact or was added. An invalid or missing tag, or one already implied by a descendant, returns [code]false[/code].

method.name: append
method.description: Appends missing explicit members from [param other] in their insertion order. A missing container leaves the set unchanged.

method.name: append_matching
method.description: Appends the explicit members of [param source] that satisfy any explicit tag in [param required]. A source tag satisfies a requirement if it is equal to or descends from it. A missing argument leaves the set unchanged.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every explicit tag.

method.name: copy
method.description: Returns a new container with the same explicit members and order. Subsequent changes to either container are independent.

method.name: equals
method.description: Compares explicit membership regardless of order. Returns [code]false[/code] for a missing container.

method.name: filter
method.description: Returns a new container holding the explicit tags that satisfy any explicit requirement in [param required]. A held tag satisfies an equal tag or one of its ancestors. A missing requirement container returns an empty result.

method.name: filter_exact
method.description: Returns a new container holding explicit members present in both sets, in this container's insertion order. A missing requirement container returns an empty result.

method.name: from_tags
method.description: Creates an independent container from [param tags] in input order. Invalid, missing, and duplicate entries are ignored.

method.name: get_tags
method.description: Returns explicit members in insertion order as independent tag values. Editing the returned array leaves the container unchanged.

method.name: has
method.description: Returns whether an explicit member equals or descends from [param tag]. Returns [code]false[/code] for an invalid or missing tag.

method.name: has_all
method.description: Returns whether every explicit tag in [param required] is satisfied by an equal or descendant member. An empty requirement set passes. A missing container fails.

method.name: has_all_exact
method.description: Returns whether every explicit tag in [param required] is an exact member. An empty requirement set passes. A missing container fails.

method.name: has_any
method.description: Returns whether at least one explicit tag in [param required] is satisfied by an equal or descendant member. An empty or missing requirement container fails.

method.name: has_any_exact
method.description: Returns whether at least one explicit tag in [param required] is an exact member. An empty or missing requirement container fails.

method.name: has_exact
method.description: Returns whether [param tag] is explicitly present. Returns [code]false[/code] for an invalid or missing tag.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns whether the container has zero explicit entries.

method.name: matches_query
method.description: Evaluates [param query] against this container. A missing or unset query fails.

method.name: remove
method.description: Removes [param tag] only if it is explicitly present and returns whether the set changed. A remaining descendant still satisfies hierarchical checks for the removed tag.

method.name: remove_all
method.description: Removes every explicit member also explicitly held by [param other]. A missing container leaves the set unchanged.

method.name: size
method.description: Returns the number of explicit members.

method.name: with_parents
method.description: Returns a new container holding the explicit members and all of their implied ancestors as explicit entries.
